title: Collector record keeping requirements.
bodyText:
Each collector shall maintain records for a minimum of five years of the following:

(1) The amount, in weight, of electronic devices it has collected for recycling and reuse and the amounts sent for recycling and reuse; and

(2) Bills of lading or weight tickets for all electronic devices sent for recycling or reuse.
bodyHtml:
[§339D-29]  Collector record keeping requirements.  Each collector shall maintain records for a minimum of five years of the following:

     (1)  The amount, in weight, of electronic devices it has collected for recycling and reuse and the amounts sent for recycling and reuse; and

     (2)  Bills of lading or weight tickets for all electronic devices sent for recycling or reuse. [L 2022, c 151, pt of §1]
